verses.text: Why are the nations raging? Why are the peoples cooking up plans that’ll go nowhere?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers plot together against the LORD and his Anointed. They say,
“Let’s snap their chains and throw their ropes off us.”
The one sitting in heaven laughs. The Lord makes fun of them.
Then he speaks to them in anger, and his wrath terrifies them:
“But I’ve set my King on Zion, my holy hill.”
I’ll tell you what the LORD decreed. He said to me, “You’re my son. Today I’ve become your father.
Ask me, and I’ll give you the nations as your inheritance, the farthest ends of the earth as your own.
You’ll break them with an iron rod. You’ll smash them to pieces like a clay pot.”
So wise up, you kings. Take the warning, you judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with reverence, and rejoice with trembling.
Pay sincere respect to the Son, or he’ll get angry and you’ll perish on the road, because his anger can flare up quickly. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
